policy.repository: Small real-data demos only; every included file is referenced by its case series.json.
policy.full_raw_data: Downloaded from the original publisher whenever possible.
policy.hugging_face: Used for upstream datasets that are already published there. A future OmniScientist Hub repository should contain only prepared manifests/indices and derived artifacts, not unlicensed copies of third-party raw data.

cases.dataset: freefield1010 + Bird Audio Detection hasbird annotations
cases.license: CC BY 4.0 for challenge development audio and annotations
cases.download: Download ff1010bird audio and labels from the challenge page; retain the first 2,000 item IDs in numeric order for the paper subset.
cases.prepare: Standardize to mono 44.1 kHz WAV and join hasbird labels by item ID.
cases.split_protocol: Five-fold stratified CV, shuffle=True, random_state=42; scaler fit on training folds only. No group key exists in the released metadata.

cases.source: DeepChem mirror of the Delaney ESOL dataset
cases.download: Download delaney-processed.csv from the source URL.
cases.prepare: RDKit Murcko-scaffold filter for biphenyl, compute chlorine/ortho counts, sort by chlorine count and compound ID, then render 440 x 380 PNG structures.
cases.split_protocol: No train/test split: all 30 curated congeners form matched observational groups; inference is performed within chlorine-count groups.

cases.license: See the upstream Hugging Face dataset card
cases.download: The data CLI reads H3/train.parquet directly from the Hugging Face dataset.
cases.prepare: Take the first 10,000 upstream training rows in stable order and retain sequence, label, and task columns.
cases.split_protocol: Five-fold stratified CV with per-fold standardization; bootstrap unit is one unique sequence. This is an analysis split, not the upstream train/test benchmark split.

cases.license: See the AI Feynman dataset and code terms; cite Udrescu and Tegmark (2020)
cases.download: Use the official Feynman Symbolic Regression Database or generate tables from the published equations.
cases.prepare: For each selected equation, sample 10,000 valid input rows and write named input columns plus target.
cases.split_protocol: Each equation is an independent recovery case; no cross-equation random split is used.

cases.dataset: Galaxy10 DECaLS with matched SDSS cutouts
cases.license: Follow Galaxy Zoo and DESI Legacy Surveys data-use and attribution terms
cases.download: Download Galaxy10_DECals.h5 (2.54 GB, published SHA-256 in the source page); fetch matched SDSS JPEG cutouts by RA/Dec.
cases.prepare: Drop disturbed/merging classes, map fine labels to smooth/spiral/edge_on, seed NumPy with 7, keep 35 galaxies per coarse class with valid SDSS coverage, and retain both surveys for every gid.
cases.split_protocol: Paired cross-survey evaluation. The gid is the grouping key and the two images of one galaxy must never be separated.

cases.download: Load the public Hugging Face dataset with datasets.load_dataset.
cases.prepare: Take the first 125 RGB tiles per upstream class and retain the eight original tissue labels.
cases.split_protocol: Five-fold stratified CV by tissue class. The demo contains one tile per class and is only a smoke test.

cases.download: The official OGB LinkPropPredDataset loader downloads and prepares the graph.
cases.prepare: Keep OGB entity/relation mappings and the official heterogeneous graph representation.
cases.split_protocol: Use dataset.get_edge_split() exactly: official random train/valid/test triple split.

cases.license: CC BY 4.0; not intended for clinical use
cases.download: Install medmnist and use the official API with download=True and size=64 for the three 3-D subsets.
cases.prepare: Retain balanced class subsets: 500 nodules, 495 organs, and 501 fractures; save each 64^3 uint8 crop as NPY and preserve upstream split/original index.
cases.split_protocol: Primary five-fold stratified CV per subset; leakage check uses the official MedMNIST train/validation/test partition.

cases.download: Use the official STEAD files or the SeisBench STEAD loader.
cases.prepare: Select 750 earthquake and 750 noise traces, retain E/N/Z components, resample to 100 Hz when needed, crop/pad to 60 seconds, and save 3 x 6000 float arrays.
cases.split_protocol: No supervised train/test split for the discovery test. Threshold is calibrated from label-agnostic surrogates; uncertainty uses station-cluster bootstrap by network+station.

cases.download: The data CLI downloads the official UCI ZIP and extracts train.csv and unique_m.csv.
cases.prepare: Align files by row; family = cuprate when Cu and O are present, iron_based when Fe and As/Se are present, otherwise other.
cases.split_protocol: Compare five-fold random CV against leave-one-family-out evaluation; preprocessing is fit on each training fold only.
